question_summary: Submitter requests confirmation of the Section 31 20 00 required compaction density for structural fill under the building pad at Pour 3, noting the geotechnical report does not clearly specify this value, and asks whether the civil inspector can sign off as shown.
deadline_text: A response within three days would help us stay ahead of the compaction testing.
routing_rationale: The geotechnical engineer of record must clarify the compaction density requirement since the existing geotechnical report is ambiguous on this structural fill specification.
